detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Chronology of events: (C) Nawab Wajid Ali Shah deposed in February 1856 following Dalhousie's annexation of Awadh on grounds of misgovernance; (B) Sepoys mutinied at Aligarh on 20 May 1857; (D) Rebel forces defeated British troops led by Henry Lawrence at the Battle of Chinhat on 30 June 1857; (A) Shah Mal, who mobilised Jat cultivators of pargana Barout (Baghpat), was killed in battle in July 1857.
Hence, option (B) is correct.
